# F5: Fit and finish, list-board

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/5-list-board.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

fit and finish, list-board (per-area reports, 4 Nov). Goals List and Table (L&T) and Board and Cards (B&C; Cards went on 9 Nov, GP); the numbers are the reports' finding numbers.
